name: Multiplayer UI design app with AI agent collaboration

mentions.name: Multiplayer UI design app with AI agent collaboration
mentions.description: A cross-platform UI design app similar to Figma or Sketch, featuring responsive artboards with a flex-like layout engine, deep design token support, HTML/CSS previews and export, and multiplayer collaboration where AI agents connect to documents and collaborate alongside human users. Built in Swift for Mac, iPad, and iPhone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a UI design app similar to Figma or Sketch, but with a few differences:

1. Responsive artboards and flex-like layout engine

2. Deep support for design tokens

3. HTML/CSS previews and export

4. Multiplayer AI and human collaboration. Agents can connect to documents and collaborate like any other user.
